summary: Iteration 20 IMBPay v2 integration — all 17 backend tests PASSED (5.63s). Confirmed removal of Cashfree, admin-only payment-config, real IMBPay upstream call surfaces merchant transaction-limit error as HTTP 400 with 'IMBPay: ...' detail (never 5xx), verify endpoint handles unpaid/paid/idempotent correctly, and regression flows (orders, pay-kit) unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3143 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, orders, payments, mlm, admin). Not blocking but breaches the 700-line guideline.
imbpay_utils reads IMBPAY_TOKEN/BASE_URL at import time. If env is rotated at runtime, the process must be restarted. Consider reading inside _token()/functions for safer rotation (minor).
imbpay_initiate/verify import 'imbpay_utils' inside the function body — small overhead per request; safe to move to module top now that cashfree_utils is gone.
seed_data_creation: Reused existing pay-kit endpoint to obtain a pending joining-kit order for EG000043 (is_joining_paid=false). No new seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMBPay merchant transaction limit currently blocks create-order upstream — /payments/imbpay/initiate returns 400 with detail 'IMBPay: IMBPay create-order failed: Transaction limit reached ...'. This is expected until the merchant limit is raised. Once raised, test_real_imbpay_call's 200-branch will exercise (payment_url returned, stored on order). Verify endpoint's SUCCESS-branch and idempotency-when-paid path remain untested end-to-end (no paid IMBPay order in DB). Cashfree removal is complete: no legacy routes, no cashfree_utils.py file.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Merchant transaction-limit rejection is a business/merchant setting, not a code defect. The integration correctly propagates the upstream message as HTTP 400 so Cloudflare does not intercept.
